outcome: Factors influencing the decision to perform CM
cohort: 185 patients with uterine myomas who delivered by caesarean section during a 5-year period
finding: The most significant predictors of cesarean myomectomy (CM) included age, surgical experience, and type of myomas.
mod_finding: Cesarean myomectomy (CM) is more often performed during cesarean sections in younger women and by experienced surgeons.
